items.hed: Rockets beat Boston 109-93 and move to 7-1
items.insight: Alperen Sengun led Houston at Toyota Center with 26 points, 10 assists and seven rebounds Monday night. Jabari Smith Jr. had 14 points and 10 rebounds. Boston falls to 5-2. The Rockets host Minnesota on Wednesday at 8:30 p.m. ET.

items.hed: Texans come off the bye with a Sunday trip to the Chargers
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule has Week 9 on Sunday, Nov. 8, at the Los Angeles Chargers, SoFi Stadium, 3:05 p.m. CT on CBS. Cleveland follows on Nov. 15, then a Thursday night home game against Indianapolis on Nov. 19 on Prime Video.

items.hed: Astros' offseason so far: six players elected free agency, one release
items.insight: MLB's official transaction log lists six Astros electing free agency on Oct. 29: right-hander Bryan Abreu, center fielder Daulton Varsho, catcher Christian Vázquez, first baseman LaMonte Wade Jr., right-hander Enyel De Los Santos, and left-hander Steven Okert. Houston released left fielder Nelson Velázquez on Oct. 27. The log shows no newer Astros moves as of Tuesday morning.
